hook.text: Your phone stores billions of bits, each on a memory cell 15 nm wide. Nanoscale memory makes the digital age possible.

buildup.text: Flash memory stores data by trapping electrons in nanoscale floating gates.

discovery.text: 3D NAND stacks up to 236 memory layers vertically. One chip holds 2 terabytes—more than a library of physical books.

climax.text: DNA data storage encodes information in nucleotides.

punchline.text: The future of memory is measured in atoms, not inches.

quiz.question: How much data could one gram of DNA theoretically store?
